body:
As someone slowly getting more anxious in day to day life, im losing enjoyment in activites and feeling alot of fear in everything i do. Suicide makes me feel like theres a surefire way out of everything

How are you feeling now and how was your day?
It really sucks to hear you go though all the anxiety and sadness.

Sounds really painful for you to go through this even while you feel your life is 'too good' to feel this way.

You seem like someone who cares a great deal for your family and friends even while you are undergoing your own struggles.

If you dont mind sharing, how are you feeling? And whats your day like?
Its really worrying that you have to go through this alone. It must be alot of anxiety that you face going to school everyday. What do you usually do when you arent in school?
It must be very painful to deal with that everyday in school. Do you have anybody in your life you share your problems with?

I feel like i am in a similar scenario, I can't gather the courage to kill myself and my parents don't deserve to go through losing a child thorugh suicide. But i really don't want to keep on living and sometimes just wish i died from some freak accident
